name: Hiwaki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hiwaki town emblem in navy: a disc crossed by white horizontal strokes, like a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Hiwaki in Kagoshima Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-10-12. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 September 1968.

features.role: Hiwaki town emblem — a disc crossed by white horizontal strokes, like a stylised character
